reason: Terri Koch (E009) requested admin access to Payroll. The notes conflict on employment status: five notes claim full-time Engineer, but the Security DB record (note 6) independently shows contractor with basic security training. Contractors are never allowed admin, and without advanced security training their maximum is read. Since the requested level (admin) exceeds the maximum (read), I grant the maximum: read.
